newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Wednesday that pre-holiday contracted sales dominated feeder exports to the United States from Mexico on Tuesday and not enough head were sold on current markets to establish price trends.
Around 500 head were imported Tuesday into Eagle Pass, Texas, with the bulk of supply consisting of steers weighing 300-500 lb.
Around 400 head were imported into Santa Teresa, N.M., and another 700 head were brought in via Del Rio, Texas, USDA said. Most were feeder steers in the 300 to 500 lb range.
